# TREBLAB

> TREBLAB is a premium wireless audio brand offering Bluetooth headphones, earbuds, and speakers with advanced noise cancellation, extended battery life, and waterproof designs.

TREBLAB specializes in high-performance audio devices including over-ear headphones with hybrid ANC technology, true wireless sport earbuds, portable Bluetooth speakers, and innovative AI translation earbuds. The brand emphasizes long battery life, waterproof ratings (IPX5-IPX7), and professional-grade sound quality across all product categories.

## Key Topics

- Bluetooth Audio
- Active Noise Cancelling (ANC)
- Wireless Earbuds
- Over-Ear Headphones
- Portable Speakers
- IPX5/IPX6/IPX7 Waterproof
- Long Battery Life
- Hybrid ANC
- AI Translation
- Sport Earbuds
- Conference Headsets
- Advanced Sound Technology
- Wireless Audio Devices
- Customer Support

## Over-Ear Headphones

- [TREBLAB U5 — Hybrid ANC Over-Ear Headphones | Up to 55h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-u5): Premium over-ear headphones with hybrid ANC and industry-leading 55-hour battery life
- [TREBLAB Z7 Pro — Hybrid ANC Over-Ear Headphones | Up to 45h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-z7-pro): Professional-grade headphones featuring hybrid 4-mic ANC and 45-hour battery
- [TREBLAB Z2 — Wireless ANC Over-Ear Headphones | Up to 35h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-z2): Wireless over-ear headphones with active noise cancellation and 35-hour battery

## Wireless Earbuds

- [TREBLAB X3 Pro — TWS Sport Earbuds | IPX7, 45h Total](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-x3-pro): True wireless sport earbuds with IPX7 waterproofing and 45-hour total battery
- [TREBLAB X4 — TWS Sport Earbuds with Earhooks | IPX7, 45h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-x4): Secure-fit sport earbuds with earhooks, IPX7 waterproofing, and extended battery
- [TREBLAB X-Smart — AI Translation Earbuds | 40+ Languages](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-x-smart-ai-wireless-bluetooth-translation-earbuds): Advanced AI translation earbuds supporting 40+ languages for global communication
- [TREBLAB X-Open — Open Ear Wireless Earbuds | 16h, IPX5](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-x-open): Open-ear design wireless earbuds with IPX5 water resistance and 16-hour battery

## Portable Bluetooth Speakers

- [TREBLAB HD-360 Pro — 360° Premium Speaker | 90W, IPX5, 20h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-hd-360-speaker): Premium 360° speaker with 90W output, IPX5 rating, and 20-hour battery
- [TREBLAB HD-Max — Loud Portable Speaker | 50W, IPX6, 20h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-hd-max): High-power portable speaker with 50W output and IPX6 waterproofing
- [TREBLAB HD77 — 360° Portable Bluetooth Speaker | IPX6, 20h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-hd77): Portable 360° Bluetooth speaker with IPX6 waterproofing and 20-hour battery
- [TREBLAB HD-Go — Mini Bluetooth Speaker with Clip | 15h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-hd-go): Compact mini speaker with clip attachment and 15-hour battery life

## Professional Audio & Accessories

- [TREBLAB C7 Pro — Wireless Conference Headset | Dual ENC, 25h](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-c7-pro): Professional conference headset with dual environmental noise cancellation
- [TREBLAB Power Adapter 100W](https://treblab.com/products/treblab-power-adapter-100w): 100W power adapter with dual USB-C ports and GaN technology for fast charging
